title: Higher-rank coherent devissage on a Noetherian algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Assume $X$ is Noetherian. Modules and quasi-coherence are on the small etale ringed site [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]. Locally Noetherian means that etale scheme charts are locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]; Noetherian means locally Noetherian, quasi-compact and quasi-separated (the diagonal is quasi-compact on scheme tests). On a locally Noetherian space, coherent means quasi-coherent with coherent pullbacks on all etale scheme charts [pqf-def-coherent]. The support of a module is the set of points with nonzero geometric stalk, in the atlas topology [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Let $\mathcal P$ be an isomorphism-invariant property of $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaves. Assume: (0) $\mathcal P(0)$ holds; (1) for every short exact sequence $0\to F_1\to F\to F_2\to0$ of coherent modules, $\mathcal P(F_1)$ and $\mathcal P(F_2)$ imply $\mathcal P(F)$; (2) for every coherent $F$ and integer $r\ge1$, $\mathcal P(F^{\oplus r})$ implies $\mathcal P(F)$; (3) for every reduced closed subspace $i:Z\to X$ with nonempty irreducible $|Z|$, there is a coherent module $G$ on $Z$ with $\operatorname{Supp}(G)=|Z|$ such that, for every nonzero quasi-coherent ideal $I\subseteq\mathcal O_Z$, there is a quasi-coherent $G^{\prime}\subseteq IG$ with $\operatorname{Supp}(G/G^{\prime})$ proper closed in $|Z|$ and $\mathcal P(i_*G^{\prime})$. Here closed immersion means representable and a closed immersion on every scheme test [def-weil-closed-immersion]; reduced means all etale scheme charts are reduced, irreducible means not the union of two proper closed subsets, and $IG$ is the submodule generated by local products $as$, $a\in I$, $s\in G$. Then $\mathcal P(F)$ holds for every coherent module $F$ on $X$. Direct image of module sheaves is [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors].

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-space-coherent-abelian], all finite sums below are coherent. By (0), (1), and isomorphism invariance, $\mathcal P$ passes along a finite coherent filtration whose factors have $\mathcal P$: start at zero and apply (1) to each successive short exact sequence. It is also closed under positive finite direct sums, by induction using $0\to A^{\oplus(r-1)}\to A^{\oplus r}\to A\to0$.

source.place: Tag 07UT, final sentences: the uses of extension closure, made explicit.

proof.text: Use [lem-sfb-noetherian-space-topology] to induct on closed subsets $T\subseteq|X|$. The induction assertion is that $\mathcal P(F)$ holds for every coherent $F$ with $\operatorname{Supp}(F)\subseteq T$; assume it for every proper closed subset of $T$. For such an $F$, [lem-sfb-space-coherent-ideal-filtration] gives a finite filtration with factors $(i_j)_*K_j$ and $|Z_j|\subseteq T$. If $T$ is empty, its empty-support clause gives $F=0$, so (0) applies. Otherwise a factor with $|Z_j|\subsetneq T$ has $\mathcal P$ by induction. It remains to treat each factor with $|Z_j|=T$.

source.place: Tag 07UT, Noetherian induction and support reduction; Tag 07UR, lemma-coherent-filter.

proof.text: Fix a remaining factor and write $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ and $H=K_j$. The filtration gives reduced $Z$, irreducible $|Z|=T$, and coherent $H$ of full support. By [lem-sfb-space-closed-coherent-modules], $Z$ is Noetherian. Choose $G$ from hypothesis (3) for this $i$. Apply [lem-sfb-space-generic-multiple-embedding] on $Z$ to $G,H$: obtain $a,b\geq1$, nonzero quasi-coherent $J$, nonempty open $V$, and an injection $\alpha:(JG)^{\oplus a}\to H^{\oplus b}$ which is an isomorphism over $V$.

source.place: Tag 07UT, last proof paragraph through the injective map; the chosen H is an ideal-filtration factor.

proof.text: Apply (3) to the nonzero ideal $J$, obtaining a quasi-coherent $G^{\prime}\subseteq JG$ with $\mathcal P(i_*G^{\prime})$ and proper closed $B=\operatorname{Supp}(G/G^{\prime})\subsetneq|Z|$. The subquotient lemma [lem-sfb-space-noetherian-coherent-support] makes $G^{\prime}$ coherent. By [lem-sfb-space-coherent-abelian], $C=\operatorname{coker}((G^{\prime})^{\oplus a}\hookrightarrow H^{\oplus b})$ is coherent; the same support lemma gives closed support for $C$. This map is the inclusion into $(JG)^{\oplus a}$ followed by $\alpha$, so it is injective. On $V\setminus B$ it is an isomorphism, since there $G^{\prime}=G$ and $\alpha$ is an isomorphism. Irreducibility makes $V\setminus B$ nonempty. Thus $\operatorname{Supp}(C)$ is a proper closed subset of $|Z|$.

source.place: Tag 07UT, final paragraph after applying (3)(b): the injection and proper-support cokernel.

proof.text: Exactness from [lem-sfb-space-closed-immersion-quasi-coherent-modules], coherence and support from [lem-sfb-space-closed-coherent-modules], and additivity of $i_*$ give a short exact sequence of coherent modules $$0\to(i_*G^{\prime})^{\oplus a}\to(i_*H)^{\oplus b}\to i_*C\to0.$$ The support formula places $\operatorname{Supp}(i_*C)$ in a proper closed subset of $T$, so induction gives $\mathcal P(i_*C)$. Step 1 and $\mathcal P(i_*G^{\prime})$ give the property for the left term; (1) gives $\mathcal P((i_*H)^{\oplus b})$. As $b\geq1$, (2) gives $\mathcal P(i_*H)$. Every filtration factor is now handled, and Step 1 proves $\mathcal P(F)$. The induction for all closed $T$, in particular $T=|X|$, proves the conclusion.

source.place: Tag 07UT, final three sentences and conclusion of the Noetherian induction.
